name: FTSE 100
summary: FTSE 100 about 2.5% below its high as energy and miners cushion it
state: The FTSE 100 was near 10,638 on 3 Nov, about 2.5% below its 52-week high and well inside the Watch line. Its weighting to oil, gas and mining firms has cushioned it from the US technology sell-off; oil-linked shares eased as Brent fell on 2 Nov. The Bank of England decides on rates on 5 Nov.
for_you: UK-focused pensions and ISAs are little changed; energy and mining firms dominate the index's moves.
rubric_hit: FTSE drawdown 2.49% below the 5% Watch line
why: The UK's main index — a gauge of UK-listed multinationals, pensions and sterling-area sentiment.
drivers: Commodity prices, sterling, global risk appetite, UK policy and banking sector news.

rubric.watch: Drawdown 5–12%, or a single-day fall > 2.5% this week.
rubric.normal: Drawdown from 52-week high < 5% and no single-day fall > 2.5% this week.
